description: This file defines the interface for the SNMP Adapter module in a TR181 device management context. It includes class declarations, external file references, and documentation related to SNMP device information retrieval and configuration.

classes.name: hostIf_snmpAdapter
classes.description: Provides interface for SNMP device information retrieval and configuration, including instance management, locking, and data access methods.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes SNMP adapter instances and resources.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an instance of the SNMP adapter for a given device ID.

methods.name: closeInstance
methods.description: Closes and cleans up a specific SNMP adapter instance.

methods.name: getAllInstances
methods.description: Returns a list of all SNMP adapter instances.

methods.name: getLock
methods.description: Acquires a lock for thread-safe operations.
